## PR Checklist

- [ ] Harness follows `templates/harness.template.md`
- [ ] All frontmatter fields complete
- [ ] Checklist: 5-10 items, each with (N)/(C)/(A) tags and [Rx] references
- [ ] At least one C-tier or above source with justification
- [ ] Cross-references bidirectional
- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` passes
- [ ] `python scripts/generate_index.py --check` passes
- [ ] CODEOWNER review requested
